Al-Quds Open University – Gaza

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational

Al-Quds Open University (QOU) operates the largest student enrolment of any Palestinian university through its distance-learning model. Its Gaza regional offices and study centres served tens of thousands of students across all five governorates of the Strip, offering flexible undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across multiple disciplines.

📅 2023-06-12 Destroyed INC-022
Library at Al-Quds Open University was struck

In early December 2023 many libraries in Gaza were targeted, including the library at Al-Quds Open University which was sustained serious damage. There are some images of damage to the library but it is not clear if these images show damage from the 6 Dec incident or a different attack.

📅 15/11/2023 Airstrike INC-023
University campus destroyed by Israeli bombing
